summary: v135.41 frontend-only testing of the new /uye-ekle-ocr (Üye Ekle — OCR) admin page. Real end-to-end OCR round-trip executed (no mocks): synthetic 700x320 PNG with 2 rows ([GOW] Ekko / R5 — existing DB member, and [GOW] TESTOCRZZ1 / R3 — new) uploaded through the UI; /api/ocr/parse?mode=members returned both rows in ~4s. Verified: header dropdown item dropdown-member-add-ocr routes to /uye-ekle-ocr; page renders member-add-ocr-page; moa-upload-dropzone + hidden moa-file-input with accept='image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp'; 'Görsel taranıyor…' spinner text during upload; summary chips (Toplam 2 / Kayıtlı 1 / Eksik 1); Ekko under 'KAYITLI ÜYELER' with KAYITLI badge and [GOW] tag; TESTOCRZZ1 under 'SİSTEMDE OLMAYAN ÜYELER' with amber border rgb(245,166,35), editable moa-missing-alliance-1, moa-missing-rank-1 (exactly R1..R5), moa-missing-save-1. Blank alliance -> toast 'İttifak seç' (no POST). Valid save -> POST /api/members succeeded, row flipped to KAYITLI in place with no reload/URL change and chips updated to Kayıtlı 2 / Eksik 0; verified via API that the member persisted with alliance_name='GOW', rank='R3', power/castle_level null (page correctly ignores power/castle_level). Scope assertions: 0 number inputs, no power/castle/level fields, no 'save all' button, no history panel, no crop tool inside the page. Direct URL reachable for admin; anonymous visitor redirected to /login; editor (pasha, can_edit non-admin) does NOT see the dropdown item and is redirected to / . ONE functional defect found: the alliance autocomplete datalist is always empty. Test data (TESTOCRZZ1) deleted after the run; member count back to baseline 255.

ui_bugs.issue: Alliance autocomplete datalist is ALWAYS EMPTY (measured 0 <option> nodes). GET /api/alliances returns a plain array of STRINGS (["3QN","BOB","GOW","GOw","GoW","Gruplandırılmamış","RKO","SAU"]), but the code does `alliancesData.map((x) => x.name).filter(Boolean)` -> array of undefined -> []. Feature #4 (autocomplete from existing /alliances) does not work. Fix: `names = alliancesData.map(x => typeof x === 'string' ? x : x?.name)`.

Dead code + spec mismatch: the route is wrapped in RequireAdmin (App.js:144) which does `<Navigate to="/" replace/>` for non-admins, so the in-page 'Bu sayfa yalnızca yöneticilere açıktır.' message is unreachable (confirmed with editor pasha: redirected to / , 0 occurrences of the text). The review request expected an access-denied message. Either remove the dead branch or switch the route to render AccessDenied.

Element is named/tested as a 'dropzone' (moa-upload-dropzone) but it is only a <label> wrapping a hidden input — there is no onDrop/onDragOver handler, so drag & drop of a screenshot silently does nothing. Also the hint text promises 'maks. 8 MB' but no client-side size/type validation exists before the POST.

issues: No contrast/spacing problems found at 1920x1080: amber missing-card (#F5A623 border + glow) and green registered rows are both readable on the dark stone background; gold 'KAYDET' button and chips have good contrast.

Cosmetic: the missing (amber) section is rendered ABOVE the upload summary's registered section which is intentional, but after the last row is saved the page shows only registered rows with no 'hepsi kayıtlı' completion hint — user sees an empty amber section disappear with no closure state.

action_items: Fix alliance datalist: /api/alliances returns string[], not objects — map strings (MemberAddOcr.jsx lines 33-39). This is the only broken in-scope feature.
Decide on non-admin UX: RequireAdmin redirects to / so the in-page access-denied message is dead code (remove it, or render AccessDenied for this route).
Optional: add real drag&drop + 8MB/type client validation to moa-upload-dropzone to match its name and hint text.
Optional hardening: dedupe OCR rows by name — two identical names in one screenshot render two missing rows and can create duplicate members (no per-name dedupe or post-save conflict handling).
critical_code_review_comments: alliances useMemo assumes an object list from /alliances while the API returns string[] — the `filter(Boolean)` swallows the mismatch and the feature fails silently. Any consumer of /alliances should share one normalizer helper.

saveRow() re-fetches the whole /members list (api.get('/members'), 255 docs) just to resolve the created id, then also calls mutateMembers() — two full list fetches per row saved. Use the POST response body id instead.

existingByName is keyed on stripTag(name).toLowerCase() only; there is no alliance/server disambiguation, so two different players with the same name in different alliances will be wrongly badged KAYITLI.
No file size/MIME guard before POST despite the '8 MB' hint; a large image will hit the backend and surface only as a generic apiErr toast.

success_rate.backend: not tested (no backend changes this iteration; /api/ocr/parse?mode=members and POST /api/members exercised indirectly via UI and both returned 200)
success_rate.frontend: 92% (11/12 checks pass; alliance datalist autocomplete fails)

seed_data_creation: Member 'TESTOCRZZ1' (GOW / R3) created through the UI Kaydet button, verified via GET /api/members, then DELETEd via API. Member count restored to 255. Test image at /tmp/ocr_test.png.
test_credentials: admin / Admin123 (admin), pasha / pasha123 (editor, used for the non-admin check)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable OCR fixture: generate /tmp/ocr_test.png with PIL (dark bg, header 'Alliance: GOW Member List', two bordered rows '[GOW] Ekko  Rank: R5' and '[GOW] TESTOCRZZ1  Rank: R3'). Real /api/ocr/parse?mode=members handles it reliably (~4s, returns exact names/ranks) — no mock needed; call it with Bearer token from POST /api/auth/login (cookie alone gives 'Giriş gerekli'). Upload via page.set_input_files('[data-testid="moa-file-input"]', path) — the input is hidden but set_input_files works. Verified selectors: member-add-ocr-page, moa-upload-dropzone, moa-file-input, moa-summary-total/registered/missing, moa-missing-section, moa-missing-row-{i}, moa-missing-name-{i}, moa-missing-alliance-{i}, moa-missing-rank-{i}, moa-missing-save-{i}, moa-registered-section, moa-registered-row-{i}, moa-registered-badge-{i}, dropdown-member-add-ocr (inside header-profile dropdown). Note row indices are the OCR row index, not 0-based per section (missing row was index 1 in this run). Remember to DELETE any member created by the save test. Do not use bare 'selim' for login (lockout).
rca_of_the_issue: Empty alliance datalist: GET /api/alliances responds with a JSON array of alliance NAME STRINGS, while MemberAddOcr.jsx normalizes it as objects (`alliancesData.items.map(x=>x.name)` or `alliancesData.map(x=>x.name)`); mapping strings yields [undefined,...] which filter(Boolean) reduces to an empty array, so <datalist id='moa-alliances-{idx}'> renders zero options and typing in moa-missing-alliance-{idx} offers no suggestions. Repro: login as admin, upload any screenshot with an unknown member, inspect `document.querySelectorAll('#moa-alliances-1 option').length` -> 0 while GET /api/alliances returns 8 names. Mitigation: normalize both shapes in the useMemo.
